body:
Source: GitHub issue #990 (bug, area:autopilot). Re-verified on main @ c410918c.

THE CONFIRMED DEFECT (a coverage gap, not a reproduced race). `packages/autopilot/test/helpers/recover-fixture.mjs` pins `gc.auto=0` and `gc.autoDetach=false` on exactly TWO repositories: the fixture working repo (line 52, `sh(['config','gc.auto','0']); sh(['config','gc.autoDetach','false']);`) and the bare `originPath` (lines 61-62, via `--git-dir`). Nothing applies that guard to any repository created LATER underneath the fixture working tree. The autopilot's own production code creates one there during a run: `lib/deps.mjs:97` (`installGateDeps`) clones into `ctx.paths.gateDeps(issue)` = `<repoRoot>/.adlc/autopilot-runs/<n>/gate-deps` (`lib/paths.mjs:85`), through `cloneAt` at `lib/deps.mjs:68` (`git clone -q --no-hardlinks --no-checkout`, which COPIES loose objects rather than hardlinking them). So a real git repository exists inside the fixture tree with background auto-gc still enabled.

OBSERVED (the symptom that exposed the gap; the trigger is NOT proven). CI 2026-09-10, `test (22)` on PR #988 — a diff touching zero autopilot files. `packages/autopilot/test/loop.test.mjs:159` (AC21) failed with `{"state":"failed","reason":"init-failed","exitCode":1,"detail":"init-failed: clone failed: fatal: failed to copy file to '/tmp/ap-recover-Hlp2lw/repo/.adlc/autopilot-runs/7/gate-deps/.git/objects/7f/7dd88e3f889cf3276252eeae226f4fd6cc4d33': No such file or directory"}`. The same commit passed `test (18)` and `test (20)` and passed `test (22)` on re-run.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/autopilot` (the local issue autopilot). Run its suite with `npm test -w packages/autopilot` from the worktree root; a single file with `node --test packages/autopilot/test/<f>.test.mjs`. Module map for the files that matter here: `lib/run.mjs` (continueRun/resumeRun — the per-issue state machine), `lib/records.mjs` (the run-record store; `update` THROWS on a missing record), `lib/deps.mjs` (cloneAt/buildWorkerDeps/installGateDeps), `lib/paths.mjs` (the run directory layout incl. `gateDeps`), `lib/mirror.mjs` (worker + gate mirrors), `lib/git-env.mjs` (gitBaseEnv / NET_GIT template — carries the #962 gc.auto precedent), `test/helpers/recover-fixture.mjs` and `test/helpers/sequence-fixture.mjs` (the two fixtures).

TEST-REGISTRY FACT you need before writing tests: `packages/autopilot/test/ac-registry.mjs` maps SPEC criterion numbers to test functions and `test/spec-coverage.test.mjs` enforces it. A regression test for a BUGFIX is NOT a spec criterion and MUST NOT be added to that registry — the precedent is the #962 fix (commit ca7299e5 / 763bd2a5), whose `ac962_…` tests are named after the ISSUE number and appear nowhere in `ac-registry.mjs`. Do not edit `ac-registry.mjs`, `test/spec-coverage.test.mjs`, or `docs/specs/issue-autopilot-local.md`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. THE DELIVERABLE IS THE COVERAGE GAP, NOT A RACE FIX. You are closing a demonstrable hole in the fixture’s gc guard and proving with a test that it is closed. You are NOT to claim in code comments, the commit message or the PR body that you have reproduced or fixed the CI failure — the trigger (auto-gc inside the unguarded nested repo vs. a concurrently-finishing subtest’s teardown) is unproven, and the issue says so. If your investigation DOES produce a deterministic reproduction, say exactly what you ran and what it printed; otherwise state plainly that the race is unreproduced and this change removes one confirmed contributing condition.
2. THE GUARD MUST BE STRUCTURAL, NOT ENUMERATED. Do not add a third and fourth hand-written `config gc.auto 0` call for the two repos that happen to exist today — that is the same shape that already failed to cover a repo it did not know about. The guard must reach every repository that comes into existence under the fixture, INCLUDING ones created by production code the fixture never names. Candidate approaches, in preference order: (a) make every git process the fixture causes to run inherit `gc.auto=0` / `gc.autoDetach=false` through the environment it already controls — `recover-fixture.mjs:38` builds `base` from `gitBaseEnv({ path, home })` (`lib/git-env.mjs`), which already sets `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null`; a fixture-owned global config FILE containing a `[gc]` block, rather than `/dev/null`, is inherited by nested clones for free; (b) a fixture spawn hook (`fx.hooks` already exists and sees every spawn request) that applies the config to a clone destination after the fact. Pick one, and write a sentence in the code saying WHY it reaches nested repos when the per-repo calls did not.
3. TEST-SCOPED ONLY. Production behaviour must not change. `lib/deps.mjs`, `lib/paths.mjs` and `lib/mirror.mjs` are rails: the clone flags, the run-directory layout and the mirror strategy stay exactly as they are. If you conclude the only correct fix is in production code, STOP and say so in the PR body rather than editing a railed file.
4. DO NOT TOUCH THE FAILING TEST. `packages/autopilot/test/loop.test.mjs` is a rail. AC21 must keep asserting what it asserts today; weakening, skipping, retrying or lengthening it is not the fix.
4. Documentation: NONE. This change alters no user-facing CLI surface, flag, exit code or output, so `packages/autopilot/README.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/autopilot.mdx` are NOT to be edited. (`docs/tools/autopilot.md` does not exist for this package.) Explain the change in the PR body instead.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A repository created under `<repoRoot>/.adlc/autopilot-runs/<n>/gate-deps` the way production creates it reads `gc.auto` = `0` and `gc.autoDetach` = `false` from its effective config. The test must create that nested repo through the same code path production uses (or a faithful stand-in that clones into `paths.gateDeps(n)`), NOT by hand-configuring it. verify: `node --test packages/autopilot/test/gc-guard.test.mjs`
- AC2 The guard is proven to be structural: the same test asserts the property for a repository path the fixture does NOT enumerate anywhere (e.g. a second nested clone at an unrelated path under the fixture root). A fix that only special-cases `gate-deps` fails this. verify: `node --test packages/autopilot/test/gc-guard.test.mjs`
- AC3 The two repositories already guarded today (the fixture working repo and `originPath`) still read `gc.auto=0` / `gc.autoDetach=false` — the new mechanism does not silently replace the old guarantee with a weaker one. verify: `node --test packages/autopilot/test/gc-guard.test.mjs`
- AC4 RED FIRST: the AC1/AC2 assertions fail against the fixture as it exists at origin/main, and the failure names the missing `gc.auto` rather than erroring for an unrelated reason. Record the exact red output in the PR body. verify: stash the fixture change and re-run `node --test packages/autopilot/test/gc-guard.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing suite green, with `loop.test.mjs` and `recover.test.mjs` unmodified. verify: `npm test -w packages/autopilot`
- AC6 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: issue #992 (the unguarded `records.update` in `continueRun`) and issue #994 (AC9’s bounded spin-wait) are being fixed in two sibling branches at the same time. Do not touch `packages/autopilot/lib/run.mjs`, `packages/autopilot/test/run.test.mjs`, `packages/autopilot/test/quota.test.mjs` or `packages/autopilot/test/helpers/sequence-fixture.mjs` — edits there will collide. Also out of scope: issue #324 (broad suite flakiness) and any other gc/teardown hardening not required by the ACs above.
title: autopilot: extend the recover fixture’s gc.auto=0 guard to every repository it causes to exist, including nested repos under .adlc/autopilot-runs/
